name: Nakahara
source:
A scientist and professor at XX University. 
He came to Kimachi village to study myxomycetes (slime mould) and wrote about his experiences during that time.

Later, [url=/c69402]Yukihito[/url] found his memoirs and decided to travel to that same village. 

[Spoiler]Nakahara originally came from the year 2008, which for Yukihito is the future. 

After Nakahara got driven out of the village for being too nosy, he became stuck in the past.[/Spoiler]
